title: The Stolen Badge
scene: At 4:05 PM, the station evidence badge vanished. The locker room was sealed during shift change from 3:50 to 4:20.

suspects.name: Iris Cole
suspects.testimony: I was at the front desk at 4:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The desk camera shows Iris at 4:03 and 4:09.

suspects.name: Jonas Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the locker room at 4:05, changing shift.
suspects.contradiction: The locker room was sealed from outside, and badge clips were in Jonas's pocket.

suspects.name: Kayla Vale
suspects.alibiProof: The filing log shows Kayla's badge at 4:04.

suspects.name: Lionel Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the waiting area at 4:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The waiting area camera shows Lionel at 4:02 and 4:11.
